storyline.title: n8n flow that writes carrier ETA updates into the TMS

threads.subject: Carrier ETA mails into RouteWise automatically

emails.body: Hi all, every day we copy around 120 ETA updates from carrier mails into RouteWise by hand, mostly from Nordline and Veltrans. Stefan offered to build a flow that reads those mails and updates the shipments. Stefan, can you share how it would work before we agree?

Tom, the n8n flow polls the ETA mailbox every 10 minutes, extracts the shipment number and the new ETA, and calls the RouteWise API to update the shipment. For mails without a fixed layout an extraction step with the language model on our tenant reads the text. Anything below 0.8 confidence goes to a review list in Teams instead of being written.
Sounds good. Please start with Nordline only, their mails are the most consistent. We need the old ETA kept in the shipment history so we can see what changed.

Nordline test week done: 412 ETA mails, 398 written automatically, 14 sent to the review list (mostly mails with two shipment numbers). No wrong ETA written. The old ETA is kept as a history entry in RouteWise.

Great result, that saves my planners about an hour a day. Let's switch Nordline to production on 2 Nov and add Veltrans after two clean weeks. Mails with two shipment numbers stay on the review list for now.
Production switch for Nordline is planned for Mon 2 Nov 06:00. I will watch the first run. Veltrans test starts on 16 Nov if Nordline stays clean.

facts.text: Transport planners copy about 120 carrier ETA updates a day into RouteWise by hand.

The n8n flow polls the ETA mailbox every 10 minutes, extracts shipment number and ETA (with the language model for free-text mails) and updates RouteWise via its API; below 0.8 confidence it goes to a Teams review list.
In the Nordline test week 398 of 412 ETA mails were written automatically and 14 went to review; no wrong ETA was written.
Nordline goes to production on Mon 2 Nov 06:00; Veltrans follows after two clean weeks, its test starting 16 Nov.

questions.q: How does the ETA flow decide whether to write an ETA into RouteWise?
questions.a: It writes the ETA when the extraction confidence is at least 0.8; below that the mail goes to a review list in Teams.

questions.q: How did the Nordline test week of the ETA flow go?
questions.a: 398 of 412 ETA mails were written automatically, 14 went to the review list and no wrong ETA was written.

questions.q: When does the ETA flow go live for Nordline?
questions.a: On Monday 2 November at 06:00; Veltrans follows after two clean weeks with a test from 16 November.
